summary: User escalation: agents pass every gate and still ship unobserved behaviour. Anchor: qa DONE_VERIFIED FIX-DASH-CRON-LAYERB-NEVERFIRED-FALSE-LABEL 13min before its image was built (re-verified). Design: mint-time behavior_predicate (P0/P1 apps/ rows only) + deploy-time behavior_probe riding ops's already-mandatory Post-Rebuild Health Verification (timestamp-gated, NOT the confirmed-dead vn.market.git_sha label) + new orch-sentinel OH-2.4 ratio (FULL+LITE, extends OH-2, does not duplicate) + PO-gated remediation ladder reusing the existing OH-STATE counter pattern. 7 files listed in brief §9. Explicitly does not depend on or re-mint 2 already-dead, already-tracked substrates (SHA label, OH-2/4 FULL cron never armed). AMENDED 2026-08-26: OH-2.4's `executed/declared` escalation re-keyed from elapsed-rebuild-cycles (silent for never-rebuilt services — 6/11 running services ≥11d stale, one 42d) to wall-clock age since qa_verified_at (MED >3d, HIGH >7d); its scan population un-time-boxed off the 7d archive window (DONE_MAX_AGE_DAYS=7 would otherwise drop the row from view ~day 14); adds a per-service docker-image-staleness output routed to ops (cadence gap), not agent-father/po's owner-quality ladder. See brief §6 (full amendment) and §7 (why the Rung 1/2 owner-fail-streak ladder needed no equivalent fix).
